name: Default
shortDescription: Prefect workflow orchestration server with its web UI and API, storing flow runs, deployments and logs in a persistent SQLite database.

alerts.message: The UI and API are protected by basic auth. On first load, enter the full PREFECT_SERVER_API_AUTH_STRING value (admin:password) from the environment variables.
The server only orchestrates; flows run on your own workers. Point them at it with PREFECT_API_URL set to https://<your domain>/api and PREFECT_API_AUTH_STRING set to the same auth string.
